title: Alkali metal lithium doping promotes the high stability and ionic kinetics of cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5720-5727
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07855A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Weiping Shu, Lili Wang, Siqiang Zhang, Ye Liu, Qiang Han
The layered transition metal oxides improved by alkali metal lithium doping have improved the capacity retention rate and structural stability of sodium-ion batteries to a certain extent, and have made great contributions to their commercial development.
